name: attio
label: Attio
description: Modern, collaborative CRM platform built to be fully customizable and real-time.

accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.description: In Attio, open Workspace settings, then Developers, and create a new access token with the scopes you need.

create_note.label: Create Note
create_note.description: Creates a new note on a record.

parentObject.label: Parent Object
parentObject.description: The object type the record belongs to (e.g. person, company).

parentRecordId.label: Parent Record ID
parentRecordId.description: The ID of the record to attach this note to.

title.label: Title
title.description: The plaintext title of the note.

format.label: Format
format.description: How the note content should be interpreted.

get_call_transcript.label: Get Call Transcript
get_call_transcript.description: Fetches the full transcript for a given call recording.

meeting_id.label: Meeting
meeting_id.description: The meeting that contains the call recording.

call_recording_id.label: Call Recording
call_recording_id.description: The call recording to fetch the transcript for.

create_task.label: Create Task
create_task.description: Create a new task in Attio, optionally linked to a record and assigned to a member.

content.label: Task Content
content.description: The text content of the task.

linked_object.label: Linked Object
linked_object.description: The object type of the record to link this task to.

linked_record_id.label: Linked Record
linked_record_id.description: The record to link this task to.

assignee_email.label: Assignee Email
assignee_email.description: Email address of the workspace member to assign this task to.

create_task.beforeRequest: request.body = {data: {content: inputs.content, format: 'plaintext', deadline_at: inputs.deadline_at || null, is_completed: inputs.is_completed === 'true', linked_records: inputs.linked_object && inputs.linked_record_id ? [{target_object: inputs.linked_object, target_record_id: inputs.linked_record_id}] : [], assignees: inputs.assignee_email ? [{workspace_member_email_address: inputs.assignee_email}] : []}}; return request;

list_tasks.label: List Tasks
list_tasks.description: List tasks with optional filters by linked record, assignee, or completion status.

linked_object.label: Linked Object
linked_object.description: Filter tasks linked to records of this object type.

linked_record_id.label: Linked Record
linked_record_id.description: Filter tasks linked to this specific record.

assignee.label: Assignee
assignee.description: Filter by workspace member email or ID. Enter "null" to find unassigned tasks.

get_task.label: Get Task
get_task.description: Fetch a single task by its ID.

delete_task.label: Delete Task
delete_task.description: Permanently delete a task by its ID.

update_task.label: Update Task
update_task.description: Update an existing task in Attio.

content.label: Task Content
content.description: Update the text content of the task.

deadline_at.label: Deadline
deadline_at.description: Update the task deadline. Leave empty to keep existing value.

is_completed.label: Completion Status
is_completed.description: Update the completion status of the task.

linked_object.label: Linked Object
linked_object.description: The object type of the record to link this task to.

linked_record_id.label: Linked Record
linked_record_id.description: The record to link this task to.

assignee_email.label: Assignee Email
assignee_email.description: Email address of the workspace member to assign this task to.

update_task.beforeRequest: const data = {}; if (inputs.content) { data.content = inputs.content; data.format = 'plaintext'; } if (inputs.deadline_at) data.deadline_at = inputs.deadline_at; if (inputs.is_completed) data.is_completed = inputs.is_completed === 'true'; if (inputs.linked_object && inputs.linked_record_id) data.linked_records = [{target_object: inputs.linked_object, target_record_id: inputs.linked_record_id}]; if (inputs.assignee_email) data.assignees = [{workspace_member_email_address: inputs.assignee_email}]; if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field must be provided to update the task.'); request.body = {data}; return request;
